question: List every dataset in /home/hyoklee/cae_test_data/porotomo/dasv_native_PoroTomo_iDAS025_160318160317.h5 with its shape and dtype.
answer:
All 8 datasets in the file are at the root group. Read directly from the file via `hdf5_analyze_dataset_structure` on `/home/hyoklee/cae_test_data/porotomo/dasv_native_PoroTomo_iDAS025_160318160317.h5`:

| Dataset | Shape | Dtype |
|---|---|---|
| `/das` | (30000, 384) | float32 |
| `/t` | (30000,) | float64 |
| `/trace` | (30000,) | int64 |
| `/channel` | (384,) | int32 |
| `/x` | (384,) | float32 |
| `/y` | (384,) | float32 |
| `/z` | (384,) | float32 |
| `/crs` | () (scalar) | uint8 |

So the file holds one 2-D DAS strain array `/das` — 30,000 time samples × 384 channels — plus per-sample time (`t`) and trace index (`trace`), per-channel geometry (`x`, `y`, `z`, `channel`), and a scalar `crs` flag. There are no subgroups; all 8 datasets sit at the root.

One note: I also tried listing root attributes for provenance, but `hdf5_list_attributes` failed on this connection with a serialization error ("Object of type bytes/ndarray is not JSON serializable"), so attributes were not inspected — the dataset list above is unaffected, since shapes and dtypes came from the structure analysis of the file itself. The file was opened read-only and has been closed.
